description_en: Queries a list of real-time service data sources
description_zh: 查询所有实时服务数据源
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb list-streaming-data-sources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-bp10g78o9807yv9h3 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStreamingDataSources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：**1**
parameters.name: page_number
